externalPrerequisite.needed: A separately owned auth-enabled API/UI target with a real restricted resource-scope authorizer and an authenticated test principal; --no-auth and Basic/AllowAll do not qualify.
externalPrerequisite.principal: A test bearer credential kept out of reports and source for a principal granted read and write access to one explicit allowed auth_resource_path and no access to a distinct denied path; the same identity must reach direct API setup and the Playwright browser context.
externalPrerequisite.dataPartition: Within one project and generation, seed or provide path-tagged resources and relationship edges for two allowed mapped Specimens plus one allowed unmapped Specimen, and at least one denied-path witness. Keep route edges path-consistent; do not create cross-path edges that blur the authorization boundary.
externalPrerequisite.oracle: An independent trusted setup/oracle identity must bind project, generation and the actual allowed path set, and separately identify denied witness IDs for negative leakage assertions without exposing those IDs to the restricted browser.
externalPrerequisite.whyExternal: The focused server regression proves selection scoping only. It does not exercise authenticated browser/API repair, coverage, candidate repair, or preview. The Epoch72 no-auth browser/direct helper and project/generation-only oracle cannot prove those boundaries, and no authenticated UI target/principal/path partition is available in the current case evidence.

Coverage and native preview match exact authorized membership and route-derived outputs; denied resources do not affect counts, repair choices or preview rows.

Removing the allowed unmapped member yields exactly the two allowed mapped members, preserves the scope digest, project, generation, saved route, columns and construction, and records only the intended exclusion.
Reload preserves that exact membership, route, columns and construction; coverage and preview still match the independent allowed-path oracle.

Clearing to all authorized rows displays exactly the independent authorized source set, never denied-path rows; reattachment and a second reload restore the same repaired two-member selection and saved route.
Denied witness IDs and denied-only counts do not appear in captured browser text, requests/responses, selection membership, coverage, preview or reload state.
